meta.name: add-educational-comments
meta.description: Add educational comments to the file specified, or prompt asking for file to comment if one is not provided.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为代码文件添加教学注释
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望为代码添加解释性注释帮助他人理解。
copy.tagline_en: Add educational comments to code files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add explanatory comments to help others understand code.

howto.what: 为代码文件添加教育性注释，解释代码的设计思路和原理；若未指定文件，会主动询问并提供匹配的文件列表。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加教育注释（如使用 /add-educational-comments 命令），或提供代码文件时触发。

say.text: 给我的Python文件添加教育注释
say.note: Claude会要求你提供文件或直接处理已上传的文件。

say.text: 给这个代码加注释，注重基础解释
say.note: 会以基础知识水平添加注释。

say.text: 给my_script.py加注释，注释细节设为3

howto.what_en: Adds educational comments to code files, explaining the reasoning behind the code. If no file is provided, it asks for one and offers a numbered list of close matches for selection.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests educational commenting (e.g., using the /add-educational-comments command) or provides a code file.

say_en.text: Add educational comments to my Python file
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the file or process the attached one.

say_en.text: Comment this code focusing on basic explanations
Add comments to my_script.py with detail level 3
say_en.note: More in-depth explanations will be added.
